Practised taking-away stories within 9.
Counted back on a number line in two attempts.
Solved subtraction-order and addition-link questions in four attempts.
Solved one of two “how many more” comparing stories; one mix-up remained.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised taking away, counting back, and checking subtraction with related addition facts. They used the story details and number-line counting in their answers. In one “how many more” question, they treated the question as adding the two numbers, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use small objects and ask, “How many more does this group have?” before finding the difference.
